rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for the physical features and shape of a place’s land.

example.english: The topography of this place is very complex.
example.traditional: 呢個地方嘅地形好複雜。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 dei6 jing4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a map or diagram that shows the surface features of a place.

example.english: This map shows the topography clearly; you can even see the valleys.
example.traditional: 呢張地形圖畫得好清楚，連山谷都睇到。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 dei6 jing4 tou4 waak6 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 lin4 saan1 guk1 dou1 tai2 dou2
